QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member
#else
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member
#endif` and "By default, `ssl->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` becomes `ssl->private_state`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both macro definitions and states that by default the member is renamed to private_<member>, while defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS expands it to the bare member name.
